name: 53072 · Pewaukee, WI
findings: ZIP 53072 (Pewaukee) has 121 nonprofit organizations. 51 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 44 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 53072 (Pewaukee) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
